subject_session: All four sessions: assets 31f22c47, 81169999, e7fa5ae0, f791a116 (591/794/303/388 good units)

headline_stat.name: pre-stimulus choice balanced accuracy per session (vs 0.50 null); Stouffer combined p

stated_limitation: Trial counts are smaller (~60-120 per session), so power is limited, but the pattern should mirror the all-trials result.

justification.dataset: DANDI 000149 (IBL ephys with 0.8/0.5/0.2 block priors) is the canonical dataset for block-driven decision bias, exactly the right choice.
justification.handling: Real data streamed via LINDI and cached, good-unit filtering applied, and the block-shifted psychometric curves independently confirm correct choice/contrast coding and alignment.
justification.analysis: Appropriate logistic-regression decoding with proper permutation and stratified within-block/previous-choice nulls, time-course, and single-unit ROC; only the per-region analysis lacks multiple-comparison correction.
justification.correctness: Reported per-session accuracies reproduce from committed benchmark_results.npy, are internally consistent with the figures, and rest on fixed-seed deterministic permutation statistics.
justification.figures: All figures are labeled with units, sample sizes, and null distributions, and example units are selected by AUC (the single-unit effect strength) rather than a spurious criterion.
justification.honesty: The write-up is carefully calibrated: it reports one session as non-significant, only the best session at 0% contrast, separates a block-level bias state from trial-resolution information present in only two sessions, and flags the within-block null as conservative.
justification.verdict: Thorough, appropriately controlled, and honestly caveated work that an expert would accept and build on.
